miriam (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount signal, internal mobility, and the new credit mechanics. dropping concise answers + next steps.
kevin (Eng Manager): thanks! quick Q: you mentioned 'roll-forward credits' during the Q. what are those?
miriam (People Ops): roll-forward credits = unused hiring credits that can be carried to the next quarter for the same hub if tied to a committed milestone (e.g., Dedicated GA). they aren't transferrable across hubs without committee approval.
anya (Product): will roll-forward credits be visible in the tracker? PMs need to plan roadmaps around them.
ops-bot: [automated] tracker updated nightly. roll-forward and pilot-credit columns added -> https://redwood/hiring-tracker
felix (Finance): to add: roll-forward credits expire after 2 quarters unless explicitly extended by the committee for long projects. finance will flag expiry dates in the tracker.
kevin (Eng Manager): internal mobility 1 some folks want to rotate into product pods. does a rotation consume a hiring slot?
miriam (People Ops): rotations <= 12 weeks are documented as "rotation" and don't consume net headcount. rotations >12 weeks are treated as transfers and trigger the backfill review. please add "rotation" to the form when applicable.
kevin (Eng Manager): cool. what about backfills when a transfer happens? is there a grace period to backfill?
miriam (People Ops): yes 12-week backfill grace. originating org can request a temporary contractor while they find permanent hire; that contractor doesn't consume permanent headcount but needs budget signoff.{hiring-bot}: [automated] hiring form open: https://redwood/hiring-form | deadline: Fri 6pm PT
anya (Product): senior vs junior mix  are we shifting senior heavy this quarter? a few PMs asked about hiring more juniors to expand buses.
felix (Finance): committee prefers senior hires for infra/platform where ramp cost is high. product teams with documented mentorship plans can still submit junior hires; include a "mentor-owner" field on the form.
noah (CEO): adding context 1 we want speed + leverage. prioritize hires that unblock revenue or materially reduce serving cost.
kevin (Eng Manager): offers in flight 1 have two candidates with verbal accepts but no slot. can we fast-track?
miriam (People Ops): mark the form "urgent-offer" and tag me. we have a 48-72h fast-track SLA for live offers. if needed, DM me and i'll escalate.
anya (Product): interview loops 1 any changes to panels or scorecards?
miriam (People Ops): loops are unchanged. small ask: add a one-liner in the scorecard: "expected 90-day impact" and if relevant, "mentor-owner" or "rotation". that helps committee triage.
kevin (Eng Manager): relocation and sign-on 1 any limits? some candidates expect full relocation.
felix (Finance): standard relocation policy applies. committee may approve exceptions for high-impact or hard-to-fill roles; approvals require People Ops + Finance signoff.
ops-bot: [automated] note: hiring committee meets Tuesdays; decisions posted within 7 business days unless flagged urgent.
noah (CEO): this is about focused growth, not headcount cuts. managers 1 be concrete about outcomes and timelines in the form. we'll publish a short FAQ + tracker link in #all-hands in 30m. :sparkles:
miriam (People Ops): thanks all 1 ping me or ops-bot for urgent cases. I'll update this thread when the FAQ is live. :white_check_mark:
